messages:
alex_choi: Hey folks — first day! I accepted the GitHub org invite but a modal popped up asking me to 'Claim this account' and to choose an email. I used my work email and it still won't show any repos. Anyone run into this? :wave:
onboarding-bot: Welcome @alex_choi! If you accepted and can't see repos, it's often because you haven't been added to any teams yet or there's an email/account conflict. Ping @it-support with the email you used.
alex_choi: I already tried logout/login and incognito. When I try to pick my work email it errors: "This email is already associated with another account". I don't have a personal GH account with that exact email though.
it-support: Hi Alex — can you DM me the exact work email? Usually GitHub will attach an invite to a pre-existing account if that email is listed on it as a secondary address. Also confirm whether your personal account has 2FA.
alex_choi: DM sent. My personal account has 2FA and a different primary email. Work email (alex@workmail.com) isn't listed as primary on personal account from what I can tell. The modal gives options to "transfer" or "claim".
rebecca: Fwiw I hit this when my GitHub had my work email as a secondary. GitHub then prompts the "claim/transfer" flow. Two options: remove the email from the personal account, or we have infra reissue a new invite/SAML link.
sam_w: @it-support we should check the org's pending invites and whether the invite was created as an SSO-required invite. If it's a non-SSO invite and the email is tied elsewhere, that explains it.
it-support: I inspected the org invites — there is a pending invite to alex@workmail.com, but GitHub flagged that email as attached to an existing account. I reissued an SSO-style invite and also cleared the old pending invite. Try opening the new link in incognito: https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/invitation
alex_choi: Tried the new link in incognito and it redirected me to the SSO sign-in. After signing in via SSO I can now see the org and some repos (product-engineering). Looks like SSO fixed it. Thanks! :tada:
devops-bot: Automated: added alex_choi to team product-engineering. If you need access to additional repos (infra, deploy-scripts), please request via #eng-infra or ping @rebecca.
rebecca: Welcome aboard @alex_choi — added you to the Slack channels and the default team mappings. If anything missing, DM me and I'll escalate. Congratulations! :v:
